name: LABORATORY REFRIGERATOR
desc: Double-Door Laboratory Refrigerator designed for high-capacity, precise climate-controlled storage of biological products within a strict 2°C to 8°C range. Features a massive 1000-liter SS 304 internal chamber with 8 perforated trays and an advanced microprocessor touch display controller.
features: Stable micro-climate control from 2°C to 8°C with ±0.5°C stability
Microprocessor-Based Digital Touch Display Temperature Controller
Motorized Forced Air Cooling System for perfect thermal equilibrium
Integrated USB, Wifi, Ethernet, RS232, and RS485 communication protocols

specifications.Equipment Function: High-precision safe storage of biological products, vaccines, and media reagents
specifications.Operating Temperature Range: Stable micro-climate control from 2°C to 8°C (±0.5°C stability)
specifications.Temperature Tuning Step: Micro-adjustment step size down to 0.1°C intervals
specifications.Temperature Uniformity & Accuracy: Strict control index maintaining ±0.5°C across the entire inner chamber
specifications.External Enclosure Build: Heavy-Gauge Mild Steel (MS) structure with durable powder-coated finish
specifications.Door Configuration: 2 Insulated Toughened Glass Doors with heavy-duty key lock system
specifications.Shelves / Trays Structure: 8 Perforated Stainless Steel 304 corrosion-resistant trays included
specifications.Cooling Distribution Method: Motorized Forced Air Cooling System for perfect thermal equilibrium
specifications.Eco-Refrigerant Specification: R290 Hydrocarbon Gas (100% Non-CFC, Non-HCFC, Non-HFC green tech)
specifications.Compressor Mechanism: Heavy-Duty Hermetically Sealed Refrigeration Compressor system
specifications.Controller Architecture: Microprocessor-Based Digital Touch Display Temperature Controller
specifications.Display Panel Screen: 1-Inch High-Visibility LED screen with interactive parameters
specifications.Mobility Support: 4 Heavy-Duty Lockable Castor Wheels for seamless movement
specifications.Data Connectivity Interface: Integrated USB, Wifi, Ethernet, RS232, and RS485 communication protocols
specifications.Multi-Point Safety Alarms: Alerts for Temp deviation, Power/Sensor/Battery failure, Voltage, and Door Ajar
specifications.Acoustic Noise Pressure: Ultra-silent operational mechanics (Maximum Sound Level ≤ 46 decibels)
specifications.Power Consumption Rate: High efficiency energy-saving design tracking at just 260 Watts (5-Star)
specifications.Internal Dimensions (W x D x H): Spacious layout: 1240 mm x 560 mm x 1560 mm
specifications.Overall Footprint (W x D x H): Standard outer frame: 1330 mm x 690 mm x 2080 mm (Net weight: 150 kg)
specifications.Warranty & Quality Cover: 1 Year Comprehensive Manufacturer Warranty on complete unit
